sim2sim_validation_status: run 2026-08-18: integration lifecycle (arm/start/single-PWM-publisher/stop) works end to end. First test (state_source=mavlink_ekf) failed hover: GT drifted ~3m (+Z) and the abort-drift safety net stopped it. A second, GT-fed diagnostic path (cmg_deploy's state_source:=gazebo_truth_diagnostic, added specifically to isolate this) confirmed the cause: with clean Gazebo ground-truth state, the SAME policy held hover to max_drift_m=0.75, mean_drift_m=0.27 over a 40s hold (vs >3m/1.4m on MAVLink/EKF feedback). So the policy and thruster mapping are basically sound; the failure was driven by /brov/odometry/local_with_session being MAVLink/EKF-derived and not tracking the vehicle's true motion in that run (obs_node._publish_odometry always uses the MAVLink snapshot regardless of feedback_source). 0.75m max drift is still not tight hover -- do not treat this as fully validated -- but it is a fundamentally different, much more encouraging result than the EKF-fed run.
